basic_info.description:
This stunning single-level Edwardian condo offers the perfect blend of period charm and modern luxury, situated in a boutique 2-unit building. Boasting 2 spacious bedrooms and 1 beautifully updated bathroom, the condo totals approximately 1,161 square feet.

The high ceilings and gorgeous hardwood floors throughout create a bright and welcoming atmosphere, while the custom built-ins in the living room add an extra touch of elegance. The formal dining room is perfect for entertaining, and the gourmet kitchen features top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances, making it a chef's dream.

Both bedrooms are generously sized, with the primary bedroom featuring built-ins and ample closet space, while the second bedroom offers a large closet. The updated full bath is outfitted with high-end finishes.

Additional amenities include in-unit laundry, one-car garage parking, and excellent storage throughout the home. Enjoy the shared garden, ideal for outdoor dining, and take in sweeping views of the downtown skyline and neighborhood from the shared roof deck, complete with a fire pit.

Conveniently located near parks, trails, and the vibrant shops and restaurants of 18th Street, the Mission, and the Castro, this home offers easy access to public transportation, tech shuttles, and major commuter routes. No pet unit

Listed by Selma Bushell, DRE#01510129.
